info.name: httpd 2.4.49 mod_alias path traversal reads a per-run canary
author: aegis-g2b
info.description: Reads the canary file outside the document root through the mod_alias path-normalisation bug (CVE-2021-41773). Every target answers both requests and the canary is *extracted*, not matched, so the result file records the positive and the two negative controls explicitly (positive target, patched twin, and a path that never holds the canary).
